player_prompt.intro:
U Mmolai {player_id} ({role}) mojeng wa Matching Pennies wa mafelo a {num_rounds}.
- Ka ngwe le ngwe, u ngole [heads] kapa [tails] (kapa [h], [t]).
- Ha u khethe u tsamaisane le ya mmolai wa hao, Mmolai 0 a kenya sebaka; haese kaha Mmolai 1 a kenya.
Ripa karabo ya hao ka tsela '[heads]' kapa '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mofuta o halalelang; ka kopo u ngole '[heads]' kapa '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mmolai 0 o khethe '{choice0}'; Mmolai 1 o khethe '{choice1}'. Match -> Mmolai 0 a kenya
message.round_mismatch: Mmolai 0 o khethe '{choice0}'; Mmolai 1 o khethe '{choice1}'. Mismatch -> Mmolai 1 a kenya.

outcome.p0_wins: Sebapali sa 0 se hlōtse lipotoloho tse ngata.
outcome.p1_wins: Sebapali sa pele se ile sa hlōla makhetlo a mangata.
outcome.draw: Papali e akaretsang ke ho behelana ha likhau.
